title: Goldman Sachs More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Holdings to $1.28 Billion
content: Bitcoin Magazine Goldman Sachs More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Holdings to $1.28 Billion Goldman Sachs' third-quarter 13F shows $1.28 billion in spot bitcoin ETFs at Sept. 30, up from about $580 million, led by a 52-fold jump in Fidelity's fund, while its Strategy stake fell about 52%. title: Bitcoin Policy Institute Renames to Finney Foundation for Open Technology
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Policy Institute Renames to Finney Foundation for Open Technology The Bitcoin Policy Institute said Tuesday it is now the Finney Foundation for Open Technology, a parent organization whose brief spans open-source AI, digital cash and encrypted messaging, with bitcoin remaining a primary focus. title: Russia Lets Everyday Investors Buy Bitcoin Starting Today
content: Bitcoin Magazine Russia Lets Everyday Investors Buy Bitcoin Starting Today A Bank of Russia rule letting retail investors buy bitcoin through brokers and exchange offices, capped at 300,000 rubles a year per intermediary, took effect Tuesday, but T-Bank and VTB say their apps are still waiting on final rules.
